scientific_integrity: Classical cycle lemma, packet-word coupling and local binomial estimates provide the analytic proof; finite checks are diagnostic only. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of unbiased riffles, canonical expected-score-optimal tie choices, and first-half cutoffs; only an exponentially accurate rather than exact finite-deck law. Alternative tie strategies, beyond-midpoint waiting time, and growing shuffle depth are not addressed. Earlier equivalent presentations remain a priority risk.
title: An exact first-hit law for optimal no-feedback riffle guessing
